page.overview:
Who is Jessica?

Jessica is modeled after Diane Lane's role as Ellen Aim from the 1984 action movie Streets of Fire. Like Jessica, Ellen was kidnapped by a street gang and the story's protagonist Tom Cody (whom Cody Travers was based on) had to rescue her, which is a reference to the movie.

Much like how her father's "Macho" gimmick is based on and inspired by the late real-life legendary wrestler "Macho Man" Randy Savage, Jessica's "Pretty Doll" gimmick is based on and inspired by Savage's late real-life ex-wife and valet Miss Elizabeth.

Jessica shares some similarities with Marian Kelly from Technōs Japan's Double Dragon. Both women are blonde, both wear a red dress, both were kidnapped by a dangerous street gang (Jessica was kidnapped by the Mad Gear Gang while Marian was kidnapped by the Black Warriors), and both were rescued by their respective boyfriends (Cody saving Jessica and Billy Lee saving Marian). Marian's fate, however, would depend on the series; she would either be a tragic plot point with her death (which is since retconned) or end up becoming a fighter herself alongside Billy.

It may be possible that the character is named after Jessica Rabbit from Who Framed Roger Rabbit. She is also another voluptuous, red-dress wearing beauty who is also famous and was held hostage by the main antagonist Judge Doom.
